_notes.note: Win rates are lolalytics Mundo top matchup data, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (site label 16.19), pulled 2026-09-30. Samples are small (roughly 190 to 2,200 games per matchup), so treat differences of 2 points or less as noise. op.gg cross-checks are noted per entry where they disagree. Mundo's overall Emerald+ top win rate on lolalytics is about 51.4%.

Aatrox.name: Aatrox
Aatrox.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 1,569 games
Aatrox.summary: Aatrox is favored. His Deathbringer Stance (passive) and Umbral Dash (E) let him out-heal and out-trade you in extended fights, and World Ender (R) beats your all-ins. Dodge the Q edges, trade only when his Q is down, and buy Bramble Vest early.
Aatrox.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Biscuit Delivery). Doran's Helm start helps you survive the poke.
Aatrox.summoners: Flash + Ignite (Ignite cuts his healing and wins short all-ins); Flash + Teleport if you fall behind
Aatrox.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (Doran's Helm + Health Potion is the default)
Aatrox.buildNotes: Bramble Vest on first back, then Heartsteel > Plated Steelcaps > Thornmail (finish it once he is healing and hitting hard) > Warmog's Armor. Spirit Visage is not needed unless his team is heavy AP.
Aatrox.skillNotes: Start Q. Take E at 2 (or W if you plan to trade), W at 3. Max Q first, then E.

lvl1_3: Stand so his Q hits you on the inner part, not the sweet-spot edge. Walk into him as he winds up Q.
Trade right after he uses a Q, when it has a cooldown. Q him from max range and step back.
Don't take even trades. He heals from Deathbringer Stance every time he hits a champion.
lvl4_5: Sidestep or walk toward the middle of Infernal Chains (W) so it doesn't drag you back. Q him while he is in it.
Farm under tower if he is ahead in levels. Your Q is a safe last hit.
post6: Don't fight inside World Ender (R). He heals and gets move speed. Turn on Heart Zapper (W) only when the fight is short or he is low.
Use Maximum Dosage (R) to heal back after a trade, then walk away and let his R end.
midgame: Buy Thornmail as soon as he has an item. Hit him while his R is used up.
Splitting is hard against him. Stay near your team and wait for his Q to miss.
lategame: Front line and let him engage on you with your R ready. Never chase him into his team while his R is up.

threats: Darkin Blade (Q) sweet spot knockup, and it combos into a W pull.
Deathbringer Stance (passive) and R healing beat your sustain in long fights.
Umbral Dash (E) lets him reposition Q and dodge your cleavers.
killWindows: Right after he misses Q3 or uses E.
When he has used his R and you have Ignite plus Thornmail.
avoid: Standing at the edge of Q range.
Long all-ins without anti-heal.
Fighting inside his R.

Ambessa.name: Ambessa
Ambessa.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 774 games
Ambessa.summary: Ambessa is favored. She dashes through you, has burst, and gets sustain that is hard to stop. You beat her early when you play behind minions, and after level 6 you must answer her with anti-heal on first back.
Ambessa.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Biscuit Delivery)
Ambessa.summoners: Flash + Ignite; Flash + Teleport to play safe
Ambessa.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (Doran's Helm + Health Potion also fine)
Ambessa.buildNotes: Bramble Vest on first back, then Heartsteel > Plated Steelcaps > Thornmail > Warmog's Armor. Sunfire Aegis is a good second item into her all-in.
Ambessa.skillNotes: Start Q. E at 2 for trades, W at 3. Max Q, then E.

lvl1_3: Play behind minions so her dashes can't reach you without going through the wave. Punish her when she walks up.
Cleaver her when she steps in for a last hit. Her energy is limited early, so trade when she has just dashed.
lvl4_5: Don't stand still when Repudiation (W) is winding up. Sidestep and cleaver her.
Farm safely under tower. Her all-in is stronger than yours until you have a first item.
post6: Public Execution (R) is her all-in. Keep your distance and use Maximum Dosage (R) to survive it.
Fight her after her dashes are used. Her sustain gets hard to beat, so buy anti-heal.
midgame: Play near your team and force her to commit dashes into a tank. Thornmail makes her all-in cost her.
Take side waves only when her position is known.
lategame: Stay near your team. When she dashes in, hit her with Q and Warmog's Armor tanks the rest.

threats: Dash chain (Cunning Sweep and Sundering Slam) closes the gap and stops you from kiting her.
Public Execution (R) gap-close and burst after her passive.
Sustain that outlasts your Heart Zapper (W).
killWindows: After she has used her dashes on a wave.
Post-6, after her R is used, with Ignite ready.
avoid: Standing in front of the wave without a plan.
Long extended fights without anti-heal.
Fighting when she has all her dashes.

Camille.name: Camille
Camille.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 686 games
Camille.summary: Camille is slightly favored. Her Hookshot (E) gives her reach and her Hextech Ultimatum (R) locks you in. You win by playing safe and taking her all-in with Thornmail and Sunfire Aegis, since she has to auto you.
Camille.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Biscuit Delivery)
Camille.summoners: Flash + Ignite; Flash + Teleport if you want to play safe
Camille.buildNotes: Sunfire Aegis or Heartsteel first > Plated Steelcaps > Thornmail. Spirit Visage is not needed. Buy Bramble Vest early if she heals a lot.
Camille.skillNotes: Start Q. E at 2, W at 3. Max Q, then E.

lvl1_3: Cleaver her when she walks up to auto. Her Precision Protocol (Q) needs basic attacks, so hit first.
Don't trade when her Q2 (true damage) is ready. Back off and trade after it is spent.
lvl4_5: Stay out of the outer edge of Tactical Sweep (W). It slows and heals her.
Hookshot (E) needs a wall or a target. Stand away from walls so she can't E onto you.
post6: Hextech Ultimatum (R) locks you in. Turn on Heart Zapper (W) inside it and use Maximum Dosage (R). She can't leave either.
Fight her inside her R with Thornmail. Don't run out of it.
midgame: Watch for her flank and Hookshot on your carries. Keep Q to peel her.
Avoid a side lane 1v1 unless you have Thornmail.
lategame: Front line and cleaver her when she Hookshots in. Warmog's Armor lets you outlast her burst.

threats: Precision Protocol (Q2) true damage.
Hookshot (E) stun onto you.
Hextech Ultimatum (R) zone you can't leave.
killWindows: After she uses E to engage and Q2 is spent.
Inside her R with Thornmail and Maximum Dosage up.
avoid: Fighting near walls.
Standing in the outer edge of her W.
Chasing her when her E is up.

Chogath.name: Cho'Gath
Chogath.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 913 games
Chogath.summary: You are favored. Cho'Gath is slow and his early damage is low. You out-trade him with cleavers and heal through his poke. Watch for his Rupture (Q) and Feral Scream (W), and don't get executed by Feast (R) at low HP.
Chogath.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Biscuit Delivery)
Chogath.start: Doran's Helm + Health Potion (default) or Doran's Shield + Health Potion
Chogath.buildNotes: Heartsteel > Plated Steelcaps or Mercury's Treads (his magic damage) > Spirit Visage > Warmog's Armor. Titanic Hydra is a good damage slot later.
Chogath.skillNotes: Start Q. E at 2, W at 3. Max Q, then E.

lvl1_3: Push and cleaver him. Sidestep Rupture (Q) after the ground bubbles start.
Trade when his Q is down. He has no dash and you can walk him down.
lvl4_5: Leave the middle of the lane when he casts Rupture. Then step in and hit him with Q and E.
Keep your health above 50% so Feast can't finish you.
post6: Feast (R) executes on true damage. Don't fight at low HP once he has R. Turn on Maximum Dosage (R) before the fight, not after.
All-in with Ignite when his Q is down.
midgame: He gets tankier with Feast stacks. Play on the side and take towers. Spirit Visage plus Warmog's Armor beat his AP poke.
Don't get caught by Rupture and a follow-up. Stay with your team.
lategame: He is a big tank. Hit the carries. Titanic Hydra and Heartsteel let you fight him.

threats: Rupture (Q) knockup and slow.
Feast (R) true damage execute.
Vorpal Spikes (E) poke while you cleaver him.
killWindows: Right after Rupture misses.
Early levels when he has no Feast stacks.
avoid: Standing in the ground bubbles of Rupture.
Low HP fights after level 6.

Darius.name: Darius
Darius.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 2,059 games (op.gg Emerald+ lists Darius as a counter at 53.16% with 1,392 games, and the direction of its column was not clear, so lolalytics is used)
Darius.summary: You are favored on lolalytics. Darius wants short bleed stacks, but Mundo out-heals and kites his Q with cleavers. Never fight at 5 bleed stacks, and watch Noxian Guillotine (R) when you are low.
Darius.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Biscuit Delivery)
Darius.summoners: Flash + Ignite; Flash + Teleport also fine
Darius.buildNotes: Heartsteel or Sunfire Aegis first > Plated Steelcaps > Thornmail > Warmog's Armor. Buy Bramble Vest early if his Q healing wins trades.
Darius.skillNotes: Start Q. E at 2, W at 3. Max Q, then E.

lvl1_3: Cleaver him from max range and stay out of his Decimate (Q) outer edge. Walk into the handle if he casts it.
Don't auto trade with bleed stacks on you. Back off, heal, then poke again.
lvl4_5: Use Heart Zapper (W) only when he is next to you and you are ready to trade. It drains you fast.
Trade when his Q is on cooldown. Apprehend (E) pulls you, so don't walk away after cleaver into it.
post6: Noxian Guillotine (R) is true damage that scales with bleed. Stay above 40% HP. Use Maximum Dosage (R) early in the fight.
You win the all-in after his E and Q are used.
midgame: Thornmail makes his bleed autos costly. Play near your team and split push when he is away.
Never take a long fight with 5 bleed stacks on you.
lategame: Warmog's Armor and Heartsteel keep you alive. Hit his team's back line and let him come to you.

threats: Decimate (Q) heals him and applies bleed.
Apprehend (E) pull.
Noxian Guillotine (R) true damage execute that resets on kills.
killWindows: After his Q misses and his E is used.
When he is below 50% and you have Ignite.
avoid: Trading with 3 or more bleed stacks.
Standing at blade range while his Q is up.
Low HP near his R.

Fiora.name: Fiora
Fiora.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 810 games
Fiora.summary: Slightly unfavored and it gets worse late. Bully her early with cleavers before her healing and Riposte matter, then buy Thornmail because she scales past you. Her Riposte (W) can negate your Infected Bonesaw (Q) slow and damage, so cleaver her when it is down.
Fiora.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Biscuit Delivery). Ignite makes early bullying stronger.
Fiora.summoners: Flash + Ignite (bully lane); Flash + Teleport if you cannot win lane
Fiora.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (Doran's Helm + Health Potion also fine)
Fiora.buildNotes: Bramble Vest on first back, then Heartsteel > Plated Steelcaps > Thornmail > Randuin's Omen or Warmog's Armor. Thornmail is key against her because of her vital procs and Grand Challenge healing.
Fiora.skillNotes: Start Q. E at 2, W at 3. Max Q, then E. Take W early if you plan to trade with her.

lvl1_3: Cleaver her from max range. Step back when a vital faces you. Don't let her auto you for free.
Trade when Riposte (W) is down. If she parries a cleaver, back off and wait for it to reset.
lvl4_5: Fight before her healing scales. Her Bladework (E) crits at level 3 and hurts if you stand still.
Use Heart Zapper (W) only after she has used Lunge (Q).
post6: Grand Challenge (R) heals her and gets vital marks. Kill her fast with Ignite and Maximum Dosage (R) or leave.
Don't chase her into her team once R is on.
midgame: You don't beat her late in a 1v1. Group with your team and take objectives. Thornmail makes her lose fights.
Ward her flank paths. She splits harder than you.
lategame: Peel her out and stay with your team. Front line with Heartsteel and Warmog's Armor. Use Ignite before her R heals her.

threats: Riposte (W) blocks and returns damage if you hit her with CC.
Vitals and Grand Challenge (R) heals.
Lunge (Q) mobility to dodge cleavers.
Late-game 1v1 scaling.
killWindows: Levels 1-3 when her Riposte is down and you have Ignite.
After she uses Lunge (Q) with no dash left.
avoid: Letting her hit vitals for free.
Long 1v1s in side lane late.
Fights without Thornmail once she has R.

Gangplank.name: Gangplank
Gangplank.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 1,149 games
Gangplank.summary: You are slightly favored. Gangplank's Parrrley (Q) poke and Powder Keg (E) barrels hurt, but Mundo heals and gets tanky. Stay away from barrels, use cleavers and Health Potions to trade, and play for Heartsteel scaling.
Gangplank.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Biscuit Delivery)
Gangplank.summoners: Flash + Ignite; Flash + Teleport if you want to play safe
Gangplank.start: Doran's Helm + Health Potion (Doran's Shield + Health Potion also fine)
Gangplank.buildNotes: Heartsteel > Plated Steelcaps or Mercury's Treads (only if his team has heavy magic damage or CC) > Warmog's Armor > Titanic Hydra. Sunfire Aegis if he is poking you a lot.
Gangplank.skillNotes: Start Q. E at 2, W at 3. Max Q, then E.

lvl1_3: Break the first barrel with an auto or cleaver only when he is not next to it. Avoid standing next to barrels.
Cleaver him when he goes for Parrrley last hits. Trade when his Q is down.
lvl4_5: Watch his Powder Keg count. A chained barrel combo does big damage, so stay out of range of the barrel line.
Use Heart Zapper (W) to clear barrels and fight him. It hits barrels around you.
post6: Cannon Barrage (R) can hit anywhere. It is a slow, so walk out of the area. Don't stand still.
All-in with Ignite and Maximum Dosage (R) when his barrels are used and his Q is down.
midgame: He is a scaling poke champion. Force him to react to side waves and use Heartsteel to stay big.
Stay out of barrel range in teamfights.
lategame: Flank him and hit his team with Q. Warmog's Armor and Titanic Hydra let you dive.

threats: Powder Keg (E) barrel chain burst.
Parrrley (Q) crit poke and gold.
Cannon Barrage (R) global slow and damage.
killWindows: After he uses his barrels and Q.
When he is low from poking and you have Ignite ready.
avoid: Standing next to a barrel.
Taking poke without healing.
Fighting in a barrel chain.

Garen.name: Garen
Garen.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (site label 16.19), 1,206 games (op.gg patch 16.19: 48.88%, 806 games)
Garen.summary: Even lane between two sustain champions. Garen's Perseverance and Q burst beat you if you throw cleavers carelessly, but you out-trade him from range and out-tank him once you have Heartsteel. Poke with Infected Bonesaw and stay out of his Judgment spin.
Garen.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Cosmic Insight). Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, Scaling Health shards.
Garen.summoners: Flash + Ignite (Ignite cuts his passive regen and finishes kills)
Garen.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (Doran's Helm is also fine)
Garen.buildNotes: Heartsteel > Plated Steelcaps > Thornmail or Spirit Visage > Warmog's Armor. Buy Thornmail early if he builds Trinity Force or Sundered Sky: it cuts his heals and reflects his spin.
Garen.skillNotes: Start Q. Take W or E at 2, max E first, then Q, then W. Use Q from range to keep his passive Perseverance from resetting.

lvl1_3: Poke with Infected Bonesaw (Q) when he walks up to last hit. Stay at range so his Decisive Strike (Q) can't reach you.
Don't trade while his Perseverance regen is running. Poke, then back off until he stops regenerating.
Use Blunt Force Trauma (E) on a wave with minions low, or on him when he is committed to his Q.
lvl4_5: Turn on Heart Zapper (W) only when he is already in melee range, then turn it off if you are trading badly.
Step out of Judgment (E) spin instead of standing in it. He is at his weakest while his E is on cooldown.
post6: Demacian Justice (R) executes on your missing health. Use Maximum Dosage (R) to heal before he gets to your health bar.
Fight him after he has used his ultimate or his Q. Your R and Adrenaline Rush let you win a longer fight.
midgame: Split push and let him come to you. He can't kill you if you keep your health high with Warmog's Armor.
In teamfights, throw Q on his team's carries and don't chase him if he retreats.
lategame: Fight him when you have Thornmail and Spirit Visage. His damage falls off against your health and armor.
Stay above half health so his R execute doesn't finish you.

threats: Decisive Strike (Q) silence and burst.
Judgment (E) spin damage in melee range.
Demacian Justice (R) execute on your missing health.
Perseverance regen makes short pokes wasteful.
killWindows: After he wastes Decisive Strike (Q) on a minion or in the air.
Post-6, after his ultimate is used and you have R available.
avoid: Standing in his Judgment spin.
Chasing him at low health into his R execute range.
Poking him right before he regens back to full.

Gnar.name: Gnar
Gnar.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (site label 16.19), 759 games (op.gg patch 16.19: 51.49%, 536 games)
Gnar.summary: Slightly favorable but Mini Gnar outranges and pokes you. Punish Gnar when he transforms into Mega Gnar with no rage left, and stay behind minions so his boomerang Q is blocked.
Gnar.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Cosmic Insight). Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, Scaling Health shards.
Gnar.summoners: Flash + Ignite (Flash + Teleport if you want to scale safely)
Gnar.buildNotes: Heartsteel > Plated Steelcaps (Mercury's Treads if he is the only threat plus AP) > Spirit Visage > Warmog's Armor. Thornmail is good if his team is heavy AD.
Gnar.skillNotes: Start Q. Take W at 2 for waveclear and trading, then E as your main max. Use Q to farm safely under tower.

lvl1_3: Stay behind your minions so Boomerang Throw (Q) hits the wave, not you.
Hit him with Infected Bonesaw (Q) whenever he walks up to last hit. He can't punish you easily at level 1 and you take less than you give.
Don't chase Mini Gnar. Trade and back off.
lvl4_5: Watch his Rage bar. At full rage he turns into Mega Gnar with Wallop and Crunch. Step away from his Wallop's (W) line and stay away from the wall for his Crunch.
After he turns back into Mini Gnar he has no rage. Punish with Q and E now.
post6: GNAR! (R) knocks you into a wall for a stun. Don't stand next to walls or terrain while he has R.
Use Maximum Dosage (R) when you fight him in a lane. His damage doesn't kill you with your heal running.
midgame: Split push with Heartsteel stacks and take fights where he has no rage.
In teamfights, fight away from walls and use Q on the closest target.
lategame: Peel for your carries and Q the front line. Don't chase Gnar through walls.

threats: Boomerang Throw (Q) slow and poke as Mini Gnar.
GNAR! (R) wall stun.
Mega Gnar Wallop (W) and Crunch (Q) burst.
Hyper (passive) attack speed and mana.
killWindows: Right after he transforms back to Mini Gnar.
When his Q is on cooldown and he has no rage.
avoid: Fighting next to walls or terrain.
Chasing Mini Gnar out of range.
Standing in a straight line with him without minions in between.

Gragas.name: Gragas
Gragas.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (site label 16.19), 816 games (op.gg patch 16.19: 51.03%, 580 games)
Gragas.summary: You are favored. Gragas is a tanky bruiser or mage with a lot of CC but low pressure in lane. You out-sustain his poke and out-scale him in fights. Dodge Body Slam (E) and Explosive Cask (R) to avoid his combo.
Gragas.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Cosmic Insight). Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, Scaling Health shards.
Gragas.summoners: Flash + Ignite (Flash + Teleport is a good safe alternative)
Gragas.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (Doran's Helm if he is an AP Gragas)
Gragas.buildNotes: AP Gragas: Heartsteel > Mercury's Treads > Spirit Visage > Force of Nature. AD or tank Gragas: Heartsteel > Plated Steelcaps > Thornmail or Randuin's Omen > Warmog's Armor.
Gragas.skillNotes: Start Q. Take W at 2, then max E, then Q. Use Q to poke him when Drunken Rage (W) is up and he walks to farm.

lvl1_3: Poke with Infected Bonesaw (Q) and trade with Blunt Force Trauma (E). He has few ways to punish you.
Body Slam (E) and Barrel Roll (Q) are his engage. Stay away from the barrel when it lands and sidestep Body Slam.
lvl4_5: Don't stand in Barrel Roll's zone. It slows and does damage. Trade when he has just thrown it.
Turn on Heart Zapper (W) only when he is in melee range with you.
post6: Explosive Cask (R) knocks you back and can push you into his team. Keep your distance from your side of the lane when he has R.
Use Maximum Dosage (R) when you take an all-in from him. His burst is low and you out-sustain it.
midgame: Split push. He can't beat you 1v1 in a side lane and has to come with his team.
Watch for his ultimate as an engage or a disengage on your team.
lategame: Q the priority target and stay in front of your carries. He is more dangerous with his R than in a duel.

threats: Explosive Cask (R) knockback into his team.
Body Slam (E) engage and stun.
Barrel Roll (Q) slow.
Drunken Rage (W) damage reduction.
killWindows: After he wastes Barrel Roll (Q) or Body Slam (E).
When he has no wave to Body Slam through.
avoid: Standing in Barrel Roll.
Fighting when his E and R are both up and his jungler is near.

Gwen.name: Gwen
Gwen.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (site label 16.19), 1,100 games (op.gg patch 16.19: 42.89%, 774 games; Mobalytics 26.19 shows Gwen at 57.8% vs Mundo)
Gwen.summary: Your worst matchup here. Gwen's Snip Snip! (Q) and autos deal percent-health damage that ignores your tankiness, and Hallowed Mist (W) blocks your Infected Bonesaw. Play safe, take Thornmail or Mercury's Treads when it helps, and survive to scale.
Gwen.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Cosmic Insight). Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, Scaling Health shards.
Gwen.summoners: Flash + Ignite (Ignite reduces her healing). Flash + Teleport if you want to farm safely.
Gwen.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (Doran's Helm if she is the only AP source)
Gwen.buildNotes: Mercury's Treads > Spirit Visage > Heartsteel > Force of Nature. Rush Kaenic Rookern if she is far ahead. Thornmail doesn't help much because her damage is magic.
Gwen.skillNotes: Start Q. Take W at 2. Max E, then Q. Don't waste Q on Gwen while her Hallowed Mist (W) is up.

lvl1_3: Do not fight her in melee. Her autos and Q deal magic damage that ignores your armor, and Snip Snip! shreds you at low level.
Stand behind your minions to block Q. Use Infected Bonesaw (Q) only to farm and to poke when she doesn't have Mist.
Let the wave come to you. Concede lane pressure and take health potions instead of trading.
lvl4_5: Hallowed Mist (W) makes her untargetable and reduces damage from outside. Wait for it to end before you use Blunt Force Trauma (E) or Q.
Don't chase her. Skip 'n Slash (E) resets her attack timer and she kites you.
post6: Needlework (R) needles slow and damage. Use Maximum Dosage (R) to survive, but don't chase her with it.
Fight only when she has no Mist and no E up and you are healthy.
midgame: Don't duel her in a side lane. Group with your team and fight her when she has to commit.
Buy Spirit Visage or Force of Nature and stay at full health. Her damage is high in teamfights.
lategame: Peel for your team and Q her whenever she is outside the Mist. She still kills you in a duel, so stay grouped.

threats: Snip Snip! (Q) percent health true and magic damage.
Hallowed Mist (W) untargetability blocks Infected Bonesaw.
Skip 'n Slash (E) attack speed and dash.
Needlework (R) slow.
killWindows: After she uses Skip 'n Slash (E) and her Mist is down.
When she has overextended and your jungler is nearby.
avoid: Fighting in melee range.
Wasting Infected Bonesaw (Q) into Mist.
Duelling her in a side lane at any point.

Illaoi.name: Illaoi
Illaoi.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (site label 16.19), 519 games (op.gg patch 16.19: 44.86%, 350 games; Mobalytics 26.19 shows Illaoi at 51.3% vs Mundo)
Illaoi.summary: Slightly unfavorable. Illaoi's tentacles and Test of Spirit (E) beat your Q poke, and she out-sustains you in a long trade. Stay out of tentacle range, use Q from behind minions, and don't fight near a tentacle.
Illaoi.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Cosmic Insight). Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, Scaling Health shards.
Illaoi.summoners: Flash + Ignite (Ignite for her heals). Flash + Teleport if you want to play safe.
Illaoi.buildNotes: Heartsteel > Plated Steelcaps > Thornmail > Spirit Visage or Warmog's Armor. Thornmail counters her healing and her AD damage. Buy Randuin's Omen if she goes crit or attack speed.
Illaoi.skillNotes: Start Q. Take W at 2 for damage in short trades. Max E, then Q. Use Q from a distance to farm near your tower.

lvl1_3: Stay behind minions so Test of Spirit (E) is blocked. If it pulls your spirit, walk away before tentacles slam.
Poke with Infected Bonesaw (Q) from range and keep away from the tentacles she has spawned. Don't fight next to one.
Trade when her E is on cooldown.
lvl4_5: Don't trade in a tentacle zone. Her Tentacle Smash (Q) does most of the damage when you stand inside it.
Use Blunt Force Trauma (E) to last hit, not to trade. She wins long trades.
post6: Leap of Faith (R) summons tentacles around her and heals her. Move away and use Maximum Dosage (R) if you must fight it.
All-in only when her E and R are both down and you are on your own side of the lane.
midgame: Split push away from her. If she comes, back off and let your team fight her.
Take Thornmail so her sustain runs low. Team fights are fine when you are in front.
lategame: Don't fight on her tentacles. Q her out from behind your team and stay away from her ultimate.

threats: Test of Spirit (E): pulls your spirit and makes tentacle hits stronger.
Leap of Faith (R) tentacles and heal.
Tentacle Smash (Q) and passive tentacles in lane.
Vessel lifesteal from her W.
killWindows: After her E misses and her tentacles are far away.
After her R is used and you have R up.
avoid: Fighting on her tentacles.
Standing in line for Test of Spirit (E) with no minions.
Fighting inside her ultimate.

Irelia.name: Irelia
Irelia.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (site label 16.19), 709 games (op.gg patch 16.19: 46.91%, 486 games; Mobalytics 26.19 shows Irelia at 58.3% vs Mundo)
Irelia.summary: Unfavorable. Irelia dashes onto minions to reach you and uses Defiant Dance (W) to soak your damage. You can't hit her reliably. Hold your ground behind minions, force her to use Flawless Duet (E), and scale into Thornmail.
Irelia.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Cosmic Insight). Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, Scaling Health shards.
Irelia.summoners: Flash + Ignite (Ignite for her healing). Flash + Teleport is a safer scaling option.
Irelia.buildNotes: Heartsteel > Plated Steelcaps > Thornmail > Spirit Visage or Randuin's Omen. Thornmail is important against her autos and healing. Add Randuin's Omen or Frozen Heart if she builds attack speed.
Irelia.skillNotes: Start Q. Take W at 2. Max E, then Q. Keep Q for when she uses her dash on a minion.

lvl1_3: Keep your distance and use Infected Bonesaw (Q) on her while she builds Ionian Fervor stacks on minions.
Don't fight in melee when she has a full stack. Wait until she has used her Q dash to close.
Trade if she gets too close: turn on Heart Zapper (W) briefly and back away.
lvl4_5: Sidestep Flawless Duet (E). Its first blade is hard to see, so stay away from a line between you and a minion.
Kill the minions she wants to Bladesurge on, or keep the wave cleared so she has no dash targets.
post6: Vanguard's Edge (R) walls block your Q and slow you. Use Maximum Dosage (R) to escape or fight at the wall's edge.
Fight when her E and R have both been used. You can chase her only when she is out of dashes.
midgame: Take Thornmail and stay with your team. She wins 1v1s when she has more dashes, so don't split push into her.
Q her when she dives to your carry.
lategame: Front line and Q her when she jumps in. Don't try to chase her around walls.

threats: Bladesurge (Q) resets on kills and low-health minions.
Flawless Duet (E) stun.
Defiant Dance (W) damage reduction and heal.
Vanguard's Edge (R) slow and blade wall.
killWindows: After she has used E and is out of dash targets.
When she has no minions near her and her W is down.
avoid: Trading when she has full Ionian Fervor stacks.
Fighting without minions in the lane.
Chasing her when she has her dashes.

Jax.name: Jax
Jax.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (site label 16.19), 1,186 games (op.gg patch 16.19: 50.36%, 836 games)
Jax.summary: Favorable early and even later. Jax wins if the game reaches two or three items and he has Grandmaster's Might. You beat him at levels 1-5 with Infected Bonesaw pokes, and Counter Strike (E) only blocks autos, so keep hitting him with Q and Blunt Force Trauma.
Jax.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Cosmic Insight). Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, Scaling Health shards.
Jax.summoners: Flash + Ignite (Flash + Teleport if you want to scale safely)
Jax.buildNotes: Heartsteel > Plated Steelcaps > Thornmail (reflects his auto damage and cuts his healing) > Spirit Visage or Randuin's Omen. Buy Frozen Heart or Randuin's Omen if he is stacking attack speed. Warmog's Armor last.
Jax.skillNotes: Start Q. Take W at 2 for trades, then max E and Q. Q is your main tool because it is not blocked by his Counter Strike.

lvl1_3: Infected Bonesaw (Q) is an ability, so his Counter Strike doesn't dodge it. Keep poking him whenever he walks up.
When he pops Counter Strike, back away and don't auto him. Come back in when it ends.
lvl4_5: Trade with Q, then Blunt Force Trauma (E) on a low minion or on him. Back away before he can Leap Strike (Q) onto you with a stun.
Take advantage of his early weakness. He has little sustain and you regen with Adrenaline Rush (passive).
post6: Use Maximum Dosage (R) when he goes in with Grandmaster's Might. You have more health and can out-fight him at that point.
All-in after he has used Counter Strike on nothing. His stun is his best tool against you.
midgame: Don't duel him with 2+ items without Thornmail. His Relentless Assault stacks beat you in a long duel.
Split push with Heartsteel and force him to answer you in the side lane.
lategame: Front line and keep him off your carries. Q him when he leaps and don't chase him out of the fight.

threats: Counter Strike (E) blocks your autos and stuns.
Grandmaster's Might (R) resists and damage.
Leap Strike (Q) engage and gap closer.
Relentless Assault (passive) attack speed stacks in long fights.
killWindows: Levels 1-5 while he has no items and no Trinity Force.
After his Counter Strike was wasted and he can't stun you.
avoid: Auto attacking into his active Counter Strike.
Long duels late without Thornmail.
Fighting with no health while he has Leap Strike ready.

Jayce.name: Jayce
Jayce.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 1,182 games (op.gg Emerald+ 26.19: 54.52, 840 games)
Jayce.summary: You are favored. Jayce pokes you with Shock Blast (Q) in ranged form, but you out-sustain the poke and he can't stop your Infected Bonesaw (Q) chase. Stay healthy, keep hitting Qs, and punish him when he is in hammer form with no way out.
Jayce.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Cosmic Insight). Second Wind gives sustain against his poke.
Jayce.summoners: Flash + Ignite (Flash + Teleport if you want to play safe)
Jayce.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (Doran's Helm is also fine on lolalytics)
Jayce.buildNotes: Heartsteel > Plated Steelcaps > Spirit Visage or Titanic Hydra > Warmog's Armor. Buy Bami's Cinder or Sunfire Aegis if he keeps poking you. Jayce deals mixed damage, so Plated Steelcaps early, then Force of Nature if he goes AP.
Jayce.skillNotes: Start Q. Take E at 2, W at 3. Max Q, then E, then W.

lvl1_3: Stand beside minions so Shock Blast (Q) hits a minion first. Don't line up behind the wave.
Walk up and hit him with Infected Bonesaw (Q) when he uses his Q or E. Q costs health, so only throw it when it will land.
Last hit under his range with Q if he is zoning you, but don't waste health on missed Qs.
lvl4_5: When he swaps to hammer form, he has to be next to you. Q him, turn on Heart Zapper (W), and stay on him.
Trade with Q + E auto + W. His Thundering Blow (E) knockback and Lightning Field (W) hurt, so leave after two auto attacks if you are below 50%.
post6: Turn on Maximum Dosage (R) for the heal and speed and chase him. You out-heal his burst.
He can Acceleration Gate (E in ranged form) away, so don't chase far from your tower unless he is dead.
midgame: Split push. He wants to poke and siege, so a Mundo in side lane forces him to answer you.
In teamfights, walk through the poke with Warmog's Armor and only engage on him after he has used Q and E.
lategame: You outscale his poke with Warmog's Armor and Spirit Visage. Flank his backline and don't stand in front of his cannon.

threats: Shock Blast (Q) plus Acceleration Gate for burst poke.
Thundering Blow (E) knockback and percent health damage in hammer form.
Ranged poke that wears you down before you can reach him.
killWindows: When he is in hammer form and his E and Q are on cooldown.
Post-6 when Maximum Dosage is up and he has used his gate.
After he is stuck in a gank with no dash left.
avoid: Standing in a line with the wave behind you for his Q.
Spamming Q while below 40% health. It costs health.
Chasing him far from your tower with his gate available.

KSante.name: K'Sante
KSante.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 584 games (op.gg Emerald+ 26.19: 52.10, 428 games)
KSante.summary: A slightly favorable but frustrating lane. K'Sante has Path Maker (W) and Footwork (E) mobility to dodge your Qs and a tanky early game. Only throw Q when he can't dodge, and win with sustain and your health items.
KSante.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Cosmic Insight)
KSante.summoners: Flash + Ignite (Flash + Teleport if you get bullied)
KSante.buildNotes: Heartsteel > Plated Steelcaps > Spirit Visage or Titanic Hydra > Warmog's Armor. Buy Thornmail if he builds AD and heals. He is a tank, so Titanic Hydra and your percent health damage from Heart Zapper (W) matter.
KSante.skillNotes: Start Q. Take E at 2, W at 3. Max Q, then E, then W.

lvl1_3: His Ntofo Strikes (Q) shoves and lowers your armor. Don't walk into it for free, but you can trade with Q + auto when he wastes his Q.
Hit Infected Bonesaw (Q) when he is trading with the wave, because the Q also slows him. Don't throw it at range where he dodges with Footwork (E).
lvl4_5: Trade after he uses his E. Without a dash he has to stand and fight, and your Heart Zapper (W) and Blunt Force Trauma (E) win the extended trade.
His Path Maker (W) knocks you back and stuns. Step sideways out of the line.
post6: Turn on Maximum Dosage (R) to heal and chase. His All Out (R) lowers his own mobility, so fight it out when he transforms.
He can knock you into a wall with All Out. Don't stand next to walls or your tower when he has R.
midgame: Split push and let your team fight. He deals damage slowly, and you out-sustain him with Warmog's Armor.
In teamfights, walk through his dashes and focus the carries that he can't peel for.
lategame: Both of you are tanks. Split push and don't take a 1v1 in the middle of the map. Keep your health high and hit Qs on the carry.

threats: Path Maker (W) knockback stun.
All Out (R) into a wall or turret.
Footwork (E) dash and shield dodges your Q.
Tanky early game makes trades slow.
killWindows: After he uses Footwork (E) and Path Maker (W) in a trade.
During a gank when he has no dash left.
When he is low and you have Ignite.
avoid: Throwing Q into his dash range without a chance to land it.
Standing near a wall or your own tower while he has R.
Fighting his all-in with no health.

Kled.name: Kled
Kled.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 393 games (op.gg Emerald+ 26.19: 44.53, 274 games). Older: mobalytics Emerald+ 26.16, 446 games, 45.7%
Kled.summary: One of your worst matchups. Kled wins levels 1-5 with Beartrap on a Rope (Q) and Violent Tendencies (W) burst, and his Skaarl passive lets him fight you again after being dismounted. Play safe early, keep your health up, and win after the mount breaks and through your scaling.
Kled.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Cosmic Insight). Take Second Wind to survive his poke.
Kled.summoners: Flash + Ignite. Ignite cuts his heals and helps finish him after dismount.
Kled.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion. Doran's Shield helps vs his poke and sustains you.
Kled.buildNotes: Bami's Cinder or Sunfire Aegis first back if he is winning lane, then Heartsteel > Plated Steelcaps > Spirit Visage > Warmog's Armor. Add Thornmail when he builds AD and Force of Nature if his team is AP.
Kled.skillNotes: Start Q. Take E at 2, W at 3. Max Q, then E, then W.

lvl1_3: Give up the extra CS and stay near your wave. Don't be the one who walks up for a Q trade at level 1.
If Beartrap on a Rope (Q) hits you, walk away from him to break the tether. Don't walk into him.
Trade only when his Violent Tendencies (W) is on cooldown, because it gives him four fast autos.
lvl4_5: When Skaarl is dismounted, Kled is weak and slow. Q him and all-in, using Heart Zapper (W) and E autos.
Sidestep the first dash of Jousting (E). The second cast follows you.
post6: Turn on Maximum Dosage (R) when you fight him, because the heal and speed win extended trades once Skaarl is gone.
Ward the side lanes. His Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (R) makes him engage from far away with his team.
midgame: You outscale him. Take your farm, kill Skaarl, then fight Kled after he has dismounted.
In teamfights, keep Q for his charge in and try to hit the lower half of his health bar.
lategame: With Warmog's Armor and Spirit Visage you out-heal him. Split push and don't be caught alone in the dark for his charge.

threats: Beartrap on a Rope (Q) pull and tether.
Violent Tendencies (W) four-hit burst.
Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (R) long-range engage.
Levels 1-5 all-ins.
killWindows: When Skaarl is dismounted.
After he wastes Q and W on the wave.
Post-6 with Maximum Dosage active and Ignite ready.
avoid: Trading at level 1-3 with his W up.
Standing on the tether after Q hits.
Fighting him next to the enemy jungler's side of the map.

Malphite.name: Malphite
Malphite.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 2,158 games (op.gg Emerald+ 26.19: 54.58, 1,517 games)
Malphite.summary: You are favored. Malphite's Seismic Shard (Q) poke is easy to sustain, and you win extended fights with Heart Zapper (W) and your heal. Don't fight when his Granite Shield is up, and stay away from Unstoppable Force (R) in fights.
Malphite.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Cosmic Insight)
Malphite.summoners: Flash + Ignite (Flash + Teleport is also fine)
Malphite.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (Doran's Helm is also common)
Malphite.buildNotes: Heartsteel > Plated Steelcaps > Spirit Visage or Titanic Hydra > Warmog's Armor. He deals magic damage from his Q, W and R: get Force of Nature and Mercury's Treads instead of Steelcaps if his team is AP.
Malphite.skillNotes: Start Q. Take E at 2, W at 3. Max Q, then E, then W.

lvl1_3: Trade after his Granite Shield breaks. Hit him with Q and then Blunt Force Trauma (E) auto.
His Seismic Shard (Q) slows and steals your move speed, so don't chase him over the wave. Hit Q when he steps up to last hit.
lvl4_5: Use Heart Zapper (W) on him in melee range. His Q slow makes you stay in it, so let the W burn.
Trade when Ground Slam (E) is on cooldown, because he loses his attack-speed slow.
post6: Unstoppable Force (R) knocks you up. Don't walk into him at range or in a straight line.
Maximum Dosage (R) lets you out-heal his damage. Walk toward him when he wastes R on the wave or a teammate.
midgame: Split push. He can't catch you and the tanks on his team are slow.
In teamfights, don't clump. Stay behind your engage so his R hits fewer allies.
lategame: You out-heal his poke with Warmog's Armor. Kill his backline after he uses R.

threats: Unstoppable Force (R) knockup, especially with a team.
Seismic Shard (Q) slow and move speed steal.
Granite Shield absorbs your first trade.
Armor stacking makes his tank build hard to burst.
killWindows: After his shield is broken and his Q is on cooldown.
When he wastes his R in a teamfight.
Post-6 with Maximum Dosage up.
avoid: Walking in a straight line into his R.
Trading into his passive shield.
Chasing him up the wave with his Q up.

Mordekaiser.name: Mordekaiser
Mordekaiser.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 971 games (op.gg Emerald+ 26.19: 46.71, 638 games). Older: mobalytics Emerald+ 26.15, 703 games, 47.8%
Mordekaiser.summary: Harder than it looks. Mordekaiser out-trades you with Obliterate (Q) and Indestructible (W) shield, and Realm of Death (R) steals your stats in the 1v1. Play short trades, save Ignite for his shield, and scale with magic resist.
Mordekaiser.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Cosmic Insight)
Mordekaiser.summoners: Flash + Ignite (Ignite reduces his shield heal and helps the kill in his R)
Mordekaiser.buildNotes: Heartsteel > Mercury's Treads > Spirit Visage > Force of Nature > Warmog's Armor. He deals magic damage, so build magic resist early. Kaenic Rookern is an option if his team is heavy AP.
Mordekaiser.skillNotes: Start Q. Take E at 2, W at 3. Max Q, then E, then W.

lvl1_3: His Obliterate (Q) does more damage when you are alone. Stay near minions and walk off the line.
Hit him with Infected Bonesaw (Q) when he steps up to last hit, then walk back. He has no dash to chase you.
lvl4_5: Trade when his Indestructible (W) is on cooldown. Don't hit the shield, and turn Heart Zapper (W) off until it breaks.
Sidestep Death's Grasp (E). Its pull is slow, so walk out of the line.
post6: Realm of Death (R) steals part of your stats and puts you in a 1v1. Use Maximum Dosage (R) inside it and Ignite to survive.
Play safe when he has R and you are below 50% health.
midgame: Split push with Spirit Visage. Both of you want the side lane, so take the wave that is away from his team.
In teamfights, watch for his R on your carry. Your team can't help them inside the realm.
lategame: Keep your health high with Warmog's Armor. Force Mordekaiser to use R on you instead of your carry.

threats: Realm of Death (R) stat steal.
Obliterate (Q) isolation damage.
Indestructible (W) shield and heal.
Death's Grasp (E) pull.
Magic damage bypasses your armor.
killWindows: After his Q misses and his W is on cooldown.
When he uses R on someone else.
In his R, when you have Ignite and Maximum Dosage.
avoid: Standing alone away from minions.
Hitting his W shield when it is up.
Fighting him with low health when he has R.

Nasus.name: Nasus
Nasus.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 1,286 games (op.gg Emerald+ 26.19: 46.99, 879 games). mobalytics Emerald+ 26.18 (older, 57 games) showed 59.6%, too small to trust
Nasus.summary: Slightly unfavorable to even. Nasus is weak early, so you can poke him with Infected Bonesaw (Q), but Wither (W) shuts down your chase and he scales into a huge health bar. Deny stacks early, keep Ignite, and close the game before he gets three items.
Nasus.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Cosmic Insight)
Nasus.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (Doran's Helm is also fine)
Nasus.buildNotes: Heartsteel > Plated Steelcaps > Thornmail > Titanic Hydra > Warmog's Armor. Thornmail applies Grievous Wounds against his Spirit Fire and his R healing. Titanic Hydra deals percent health damage to his large health bar.
Nasus.skillNotes: Start Q. Take E at 2, W at 3. Max Q, then E, then W.

lvl1_3: Poke him with Infected Bonesaw (Q) whenever he steps up for Siphoning Strike (Q). Don't let him farm stacks freely.
Trade Q + E auto when his Q is on cooldown. He has low damage early.
lvl4_5: His Wither (W) slows you and lowers your attack speed. Q from range and don't walk into it.
Look for a level 3-5 all-in with Ignite. Kill him before he gets a few stacks.
post6: Fury of the Sands (R) makes him big and tanky. Back off for its duration unless you have Maximum Dosage up and a kill.
Take the wave. Freeze or crash the lane so he loses stacks.
midgame: Split push and force him to answer side waves. Don't 1v1 him after his third item.
Shove waves and roam. He is slow to react.
lategame: He scales harder than you. End the game with your team or fight his Wither out and buy Thornmail.

threats: Wither (W) slow and attack speed cut.
Siphoning Strike (Q) stack scaling.
Fury of the Sands (R) tankiness and healing.
Spirit Fire (E) armor shred.
killWindows: Levels 2-5 with Ignite when his Q is on cooldown.
When his W is on cooldown.
After he wastes his R on the wave or a teammate.
avoid: Letting him farm stacks under tower.
Fighting inside his R with no lead.
Chasing into Wither with low health.

Olaf.name: Olaf
Olaf.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 471 games (op.gg Emerald+ 26.19: 48.41, 347 games)
Olaf.summary: An even lane. Olaf wins short all-ins with Undertow (Q) and Reckless Swing (E) true damage, and Ragnarok (R) makes him immune to your slows and CC. Dodge the axe, trade after he throws it, and win the longer fights with your health.
Olaf.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Cosmic Insight)
Olaf.summoners: Flash + Ignite (Ignite helps against his Tough It Out heal)
Olaf.buildNotes: Heartsteel > Plated Steelcaps > Thornmail or Spirit Visage > Titanic Hydra > Warmog's Armor. Thornmail is good against his healing and physical damage. Note his true damage from Reckless Swing ignores your armor, so health items are the answer.
Olaf.skillNotes: Start Q. Take E at 2, W at 3. Max Q, then E, then W.

lvl1_3: Sidestep Undertow (Q) and step between him and the axe. He has to walk to pick it up.
Trade Q + E auto when the axe is on the ground. Reckless Swing (E) costs him health, so he trades worse when he is low.
lvl4_5: Avoid long fights near 40% health. His Tough It Out (W) heals more when he is low.
Turn on Heart Zapper (W) when he stands still to grab the axe.
post6: During Ragnarok (R) he is immune to CC and hits hard. Walk away or use Maximum Dosage (R) to run and fight after it ends.
All-in when his R is used and your Ignite is ready.
midgame: Split push. He is a strong diver, so ward and watch where he is.
In teamfights, wait for him to use R and then focus him or walk back.
lategame: You outscale him with Warmog's Armor and Spirit Visage. Keep your health high and don't fight in his R.

threats: Undertow (Q) slow and damage.
Reckless Swing (E) true damage.
Ragnarok (R) CC immunity.
Tough It Out (W) heal and attack speed.
killWindows: After he has thrown his axe and it is far from him.
After his R has ended.
When he is low from his own Reckless Swing.
avoid: Fighting inside his R.
Trading when his axe is up and you are below 50% health.
Standing in a line for Undertow.

Ornn.name: Ornn
Ornn.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 871 games
Ornn.summary: Even to slightly unfavorable. Ornn has little kill pressure early, but he out-tanks you and out-scales in fights. Farm safely, keep your health up, and force him to answer your side lane.
Ornn.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Cosmic Insight)
Ornn.summoners: Flash + Ignite (Flash + Teleport if you plan to split push)
Ornn.buildNotes: Heartsteel > Plated Steelcaps > Sunfire Aegis > Warmog's Armor > Spirit Visage. Swap in Thornmail if his team leans on healing.
Ornn.skillNotes: Start Q. Take E at 2, W at 3. Max Q, then W, then E.

lvl1_3: Sidestep Volcanic Rupture (Q). The pillar it leaves blocks your Infected Bonesaw, so don't throw Q into it.
Only cast Infected Bonesaw when it will hit. It costs health.
Trade with Blunt Force Trauma (E) when his Q is down.
lvl4_5: Step out of Bellows Breath (W) or trade back right after it ends.
Keep Heart Zapper (W) on only during trades. Turn it off while farming to save health.
post6: Don't fight his Call to Arms (R) elemental. Walk around it and play for the wave.
Trade when his Q and W are used. Maximum Dosage (R) lets you win the longer fight.
midgame: Stack Heartsteel and push side lane. He has to answer you.
Don't duel him while brittle from his W. Wait for it to end.
lategame: He wins teamfights if you fight head-on. Keep pressure on a side lane.
Save Maximum Dosage for when his team dives you.

threats: Volcanic Rupture (Q) knock-up, and the pillar blocks your Q.
Bellows Breath (W) brittle, which sets up his team's damage.
Call to Arms (R) slow wave with knock-up.
killWindows: Right after Volcanic Rupture is used and you are past the pillars.
When he is low after a wave clash and Bellows Breath is down.
avoid: Throwing Infected Bonesaw into a pillar.
Chasing him into his elemental at low health.

Poppy.name: Poppy
Poppy.winRateSource: lolalytics Dr. Mundo top counters, Emerald+, patch 26.19 (client 16.19), 190 games (small sample; op.gg Emerald+ 26.19 lists Poppy at 55.56 against Mundo, so the true matchup is closer to even)
Poppy.summary: Roughly even despite the lolalytics number. Poppy's Heroic Charge (E) into a wall is her burst, and her Steadfast Presence (W) stops dashes (you have none anyway). Fight in open space and out-sustain her.
Poppy.runes: Grasp of the Undying (Demolish, Second Wind, Overgrowth) + Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Cosmic Insight)
Poppy.buildNotes: Heartsteel > Plated Steelcaps > Sunfire Aegis > Warmog's Armor. Add Thornmail if she gets fed and starts hitting hard with autos.
Poppy.skillNotes: Start Q. Take E at 2, W at 3. Max Q, then W, then E.

lvl1_3: Stay away from walls. Her Heroic Charge only does big damage and stun when she pins you into terrain.
Trade with Blunt Force Trauma when her Hammer Shock (Q) is down.
lvl4_5: Stand in open space between waves. If she uses E with no wall behind you, walk into her and zap.
Don't overspend health on Infected Bonesaw for pokes.
post6: Keeper's Verdict (R) knocks you back. Don't fight low health near her when she has R.
